summary: Add a tenant-scoped provider-neutral integration state center with a deterministic fail-closed reducer, immutable derived evidence and no remote IO on GET.

impacts.evidence: All derived rows, queue work and read queries carry organization/workspace scope with FORCE RLS.
Snapshots contain bounded classifications, references and digests only; no credential material, raw errors or PII.
Two additive integration-center GET routes and generated SDK methods are added.
Versioned account-status and snapshot-published payloads use the canonical event envelope.
Connector SDK root contract is unchanged; runtime support is consumed as a host projection.
Migration 35 adds rebuildable metadata, immutable evidence and coalesced recompute queue.
No remote IO on GET, no-store/ETag, bounded identifiers, field visibility and default-deny actions are enforced.
Action descriptors carry risk/approval metadata and never authorize or execute writes themselves.
Snapshot/transition/action evidence is digest-bound and links to existing source owners.
Queue coalescing and immutable action receipts make duplicate/out-of-order events safe.
Webhook status is normalized from host evidence; center GET performs no egress.
Partial, age/TTL, counters, queue attempts and snapshot digest are explicit operational signals.
Derived tables are disposable and rebuildable while source writes remain available.
Reducer, API/OpenAPI parity, schema fixtures, migration and frontend checks cover the new surface.
